attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Strength, Melee, or Acrobatics skill + 1d4+2; you may additionally discard this card to add another 2d4. If not proficient with weapons, the difficulty of this check is increased by 4. 

On your combat check, if you played another weapon, discard this card to add 1d4+1.
